name: People of Determination Parking Permit
summary: This permit lets you park in designated accessible bays and, in some emirates, in metered bays without charge. It's issued per person, not per vehicle, so it travels with you regardless of who is driving.
whoQualifies: Residents with a registered determination (disability) assessment affecting mobility
A parent or guardian driving a person of determination, when the permit-holder is a passenger
documentsRequired: Valid UAE driving licence, if the applicant is the driver
Vehicle registration (Mulkiya), if requesting a vehicle sticker
processingTime: 3 working days from a complete application (placeholder)
howToApply: Apply online or at an RTA customer happiness centre
Upload or present the determination assessment letter
Choose a hanging permit, a windscreen sticker, or both
Collect the permit or have it posted to your registered address
